title: Kloosterman multiplicities of the cut-open torus and the collapse at powers of two
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-09, before the proof attempt. For the cut-open torus walk at n = 2^m over GF(2), q = 2n, K(a) = sum over x in GF(q) of (-1)^Tr(x + a/x) with 1/0 = 0 (Tr the trace of GF(q) over GF(2)), and A_cone the quarter-turn cone of CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001A (det(I - mu A_cone) = det(I + C_s(mu)) = mu^(-h) det(sum over i of mu^(2^i) C_i), RETURN-DIGITS-20261109-001A): (1) to be proved: sum over a in GF(q)* of K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 = n(n - 1)/2, the degree of the cone polynomial; so if every a in GF(q)* is a root of det(I - mu A_cone) of order at least K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8, the collapse holds and every order is exactly that; (2) the Kloosterman law, found by exact computation before this registration: for every a in GF(q)*, the eigenvalue 1/a of A_cone has algebraic multiplicity K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8, geometric multiplicity |K(a)|/4 (the dimension of the kernel of I + C_s(a)), and Jordan blocks of sizes 1, 5, 9, ..., 4(K(a)/4) - 3 when K(a) > 0 and 3, 7, 11, ..., 4|K(a)/4| - 1 when K(a) < 0 (none when K(a) = 0); equivalently, with t = 1 - K(a) the trace of Frobenius of the elliptic curve y^2 + xy = x^3 + a over GF(q), the multiplicity is (t^2 - 1)/8 and the k(k + 1)/2 law of CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001 has |t| = 2k + 1. Target, to be proved or left open with the gap stated: (2), or lower bounds as in (1), hence the collapse at every power of two. Computed before registration: (2)'s algebraic multiplicities at sides 4 to 128 (every class, against CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001's data), its geometric multiplicities at 4 to 64 (every a in GF(q)*, on the return map); and at the sides n = 3 to 24 that are not powers of two the cone's characteristic polynomial has an irreducible factor whose degree does not divide the order of 2 mod 2n - 1, so its eigenvalues do not all lie in the field of (2n - 1)-th roots of unity.
failure_conditions: A power of two and an a in GF(2n)* at which the kernel of I + C_s(a) has dimension other than |K(a)|/4 (computed false at 4 to 64; side 128 is a planned check after registration).
A power of two and an a in GF(2n)* at which the multiplicity of the eigenvalue 1/a of A_cone differs from K(a)(K(a) - 2)/8 (computed false at 4 to 128).
A power of two with an eigenvalue of A_cone outside GF(2n) (computed false at 4 to 128 by CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001).
remaining_obligations: the target: (2) or lower bounds as in (1), hence the collapse at every power of two
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).
